analyst_view.overall: Freiburg (14th, 6 pts) host Twente (3rd, 9 pts) in a game Julian Schuster calls 'very, very important': Freiburg need a win to keep a top-eight finish realistic and Twente want to stay perfect. Freiburg have no injuries beyond Muslija (counted) and all other squad players are available, but they face Leipzig on Sunday and Kaiserslautern in the cup next Wednesday, so some rotation is possible (Grifo and Gunter could start on the left). Twente travel with 21 players and without five: keeper Lars Unnerstall, Max Bruns and Filip Thorvaldsen (counted) plus Thomas van den Belt and Krzysztof Kurowski, whom the numbers don't list; defender Lemkin, reported doubtful, is in the squad and Weghorst leads the attack. Lithuanian referee Manfredas Lukjancukas is named, and the numbers already trim cards about 6% for his record; an afternoon re-check found no new absentees; Lemkin is still listed as doubtful.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals, already lifted for Twente's scoring burst (22 in 6) and trimmed for Freiburg's quieter recent output and Bruns' absence. Twente also miss Van den Belt and Kurowski, which the numbers don't list, but Twente's attackers are all available and Freiburg may rotate before Leipzig, so the two point in opposite directions and I stay at 3.2.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.7 corners, already adjusted for Twente winning plenty of corners lately (+4%) and Freiburg facing a side that concedes very few (-6%). Freiburg rely on wide play and set pieces at home, with Grifo and Gunter possible on the left, but that is in their ratings and no news changes it, so I stay at 8.7.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.3 cards, with Freiburg's higher recent count (+4%), Twente's lower one (-5%) and referee Lukjancukas' low record (-6%) already counted. It is a tight game with real stakes, but nothing the numbers miss points either way, so I stay at 3.3.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.7 shots, already moved a lot by momentum: Twente's heavy shooting (+11%) and Freiburg's struggle against a side that has allowed few shots (-13%). Freiburg may rotate with three games in a week and Twente lose two squad midfielders, but neither changes the shape of the game clearly, so I stay at 24.7.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.0 shots on target, already shifted toward Twente (+10.5%) and away from Freiburg (-8%) for recent form. Twente's absentees, including first-choice keeper Unnerstall, are mostly counted, and nothing new changes how often either side hits the target, so I stay at 9.0.
